drowned_bell.description: A cracked bell-tongue from the Drowned Gallery. Bracing rings it: +6 Resonance whenever you Brace.
drowned_bell.name: Drowned Bell

greymaw_fang.description: Old Greymaw's fang, which Ferris says remembers the ridge. Once per battle an Edge hit ignores Brace; hitting an Exposed or Staggered foe stirs Resonance.
greymaw_fang.name: Greymaw Fang

lamplighters_glass.description: Civara-made lens. Arcane attacks +10%, but it leaves you open to Impact.
lamplighters_glass.name: Lamplighter's Glass

road_charm.description: A traveller's knot. Act a little sooner.
road_charm.name: Road Charm

wardens_sigil.description: A survey sigil from Almyra's unit. Shrugs off Arcane, but the wearer is slower to act.
wardens_sigil.name: Warden's Sigil

whetstone_token.description: Edge attacks bite deeper (+10%), Impact attacks are unchanged.
whetstone_token.name: Whetstone Token
